get_indexable_columns: get the list of indexable string columns from a HuggingFace dataset Features object
get_monolingual_stemmer: get the appropriate DuckDB FTS stemmer for a dataset based on its language metadata
compute_transformed_data: compute transformed data columns like string lengths, audio durations, video durations, and image dimensions from parquet files
create_index: create a full-text search index in DuckDB using parallel tokenization with BM25 scoring and stopwords
duckdb_connect: create an in-memory DuckDB connection with a database attached, FTS extension loaded, and external access disabled
